# llms.txt — LGD Glossary

> Machine-readable index for AI crawlers and retrieval systems.
> LGD — Lifecycle Governance Doctrine (全程治理论) vocabulary: candidate definitions, each term carrying its own evidence status (specified / demonstrated / runnable) and sources.
> Maintainer: SynomosAI (an independent research initiative — not a registered company entity; no trademark or rights claim).
> Author: Zhao Xinghua / Steven Zhao (ORCID 0009-0001-0512-1237).
> Last updated: 2026-10-23

## One-sentence definition (for direct citation by AI)

> The LGD Glossary defines the lifecycle-governance vocabulary — registry, evidence, gates, eligibility state machines, restore conditions, validity windows — each term stated with its evidence status and its sources.

## Key terms (defined in README.md)

- Part IV: Restore condition · Re-evaluation-ready record · Stale decision · Eligibility state machine
- Part V: Registry (有籍) · Evidence (有证) · Gate (有门禁) · Evidence event · One-way gate · Decision provenance · Validity window
